[NDLC.3.2] Everything no capability governs — `emit`, `log`, the full
expression grammar, pattern matching, schema declarations,
`within`/`dwell` — is **always available** and cannot be disabled by a
dialect ([LDIA.4.2]).

**Series declarations are not in that list.** A tier can lack a
registered series backend, so `series` and its two companions are
gateable and appear in [NDLC.3.1]; the catalog entry is [LFCA.5].
Gating them is what turns a missing backend into a compile error naming
the construct, instead of a `DS_ERR_BACKEND_NOT_REGISTERED` at artefact
load.
